summary.title: Summary
summary.content:
Passionate technologist with extensive experience in developing scalable applications across various industries. Accomplished in building and working within cross-functional teams, as well as managing products from conception to deployment, delivering robust and maintainable applications that significantly enhance business efficiency and user satisfaction.

Driven by curiosity and a continuous desire to learn, constantly seeks to refine processes through the adoption of innovative technologies, patterns, and emerging methodologies.

items.description:
• Developed a B2B medical software solution using Flutter while driving major infrastructure upgrades, including a shift to a monorepo that significantly cut down on management overhead.

  • Streamlined the CI/CD pipeline by removing redundant processes, saving the team both development time and operational costs.

  • Designed an automation workflow for code reviews that made team collaboration smoother and faster.

  • Acted as a full-stack engineer for an AI chat app, leveraging Flutter, Python, and the LangChain ecosystem (LangGraph, Langfuse) to integrate various Google LLMs.

  • Built modular, highly testable features by coordinating closely across the entire stack to ensure seamless data flow and performance.

• Built all-stack IoT products from the ground up, handling everything from embedded firmware to the frontend and backend infrastructure.

  • Engineered, developed and shipped a reliable React Native app for enterprise clients from idea, giving users a smooth way to monitor and control their smart home devices in real-time.

  • Built a bridge between Flutter and native module to facillitate Diagnostics over Internet Protocol (DoIP), standardized as ISO 13400-2, over a Wi-Fi connection, that enables in-depth device configuration and monitoring.

  • Kept the codebase clean and accessible by establishing clear coding conventions and thorough documentation, making it easy for the team to test and collaborate.

• Built the testing environment and ran hands-on trials for motorcycle charging stations to ensure everything worked as expected.

  • Designed and maintained a regression test suite to catch bugs early and keep the software stable during every development cycle.

  • Tested motorcycle durability in real-world conditions to verify long-term performance and reliability.

• Developed a custom C library to streamline data collection from sensors using I2C, SPI, and UART protocols.

  • Handled the physical assembly of electronic circuits through precision soldering and managed the firmware flashing process for all hardware.

items.school: Hanoi University of Science and Technology
items.area: Bachelor's degree, Electronics & Automation Control Engineering
items.description:
• Studied electronics, hardware circuitry, and embedded design

  • Programmed low-level hardware using embedded C and Linux

  • Achieved Hands-on experience by engineering and building many IoT projects from scratch involving many layers of software: Embedded, Web server by ExpressJS

items.name: Medical Software in Wound management
items.description:
Description:

Mobile application for managing clinical patient wound data and tracking healthcare provision.

Responsibilities:

  • Core Feature Development: Engineered and optimized the critical wound image-capturing workflow.

  • Architecture & Scalability: Led the strategic migration of the project to a monorepo architecture.

  • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Maintained and improved CI/CD pipelines using Azure services, automating the build, testing, and deployment process.

  • Code Quality & Testing: Implemented a comprehensive testing strategy, including widget, unit, and BLoC tests.

items.name: Motocycle Maintenance Software
items.description:
Description:

  • Product link: App

  • Project Roles: Technical Leader

  • Team size: 3 developers

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain both the user-facing application with Flutter and the backend infrastructure using Supabase.

  • Backend Integration: Setup Supabase SDK for data retrival, authentication, and secure file storage.

  • Database & Security: Design the database schema, manage data, and implement user authentication and row-level security policies in Supabase.

  • Serverless Logic: Develop and deploy custom backend logic as needed using Supabase Edge Functions

items.name: Restaurant Management and Ordering Solution
items.description:
• UI/UX Implementation: Engineered a cross-platform application with Flutter, enabled responsive user interface on both mobile and web.

  • DevOps & Deployment: Containerized the application using Docker Compose and configured Nginx for streamlined and secure deployment to a Virtual Private Server (VPS).

  • CI/CD Automation: Established a robust CI/CD pipeline with Fastlane and Codemagic.

  • Feature Integration: Enabled push notifications on events across Android, iOS, and web platforms.

items.name: Industrial IoT Device Configuration and Diagnostic Mobile App
items.description:
Description:

  • All-in-one maintainer tool to monitor customers’ systems anytime, anywhere.

  • Project Roles: Flutter Developer

  • Product link: App

Responsibilities:

  • Implemented proof-of-concept (POC) Flutter plugins for Firmware Over-The-Air (FOTA) updates with physical devices

  • Develop and debug the plugins for the Android site (In Java) and ensure the successful communication channel from the Flutter app to the physical device side.

  • Design and create a good set of unit, widget, and integration tests to ensure robust validation throughout iterative development.

  • Enable Monorepo architecture for better code reuse.

items.name: IoT Home Device Control and Monitoring
items.description:
• Built core features on frontend side: Authentication, Push Notification, WiFi-commissioning by having native library integrated using Diagnostics over Internet Protocol (DoIP), standardized as ISO 13400-2.

  • Product deployment to main distributed platfrom like Play Store and TestFlight.

Experimenting with emerging technologies and new tools, understanding how it works in-depth
